test_pipe_parity: test the Pipe module parity between regular and Pipe-wrapped PyTorch models across multiple GPUs
run_correctness_test: run the test_correctness parametrized test with fp16, checkpoint, and chunk variations
create_sequential_model: create a Sequential model with Linear layers sized by GPU count using _get_model
train_pipe_model: train a Pipe-wrapped model with configurable checkpointing and chunk-based pipeline parallelism
